name: Epipolar Encoder
definition: A two-view encoder that resolves scale ambiguity in 3D reconstruction by comparing features from a reference pixel with features sampled along the corresponding epipolar line in a second view, augmented with positionally-encoded depths to record correct depths consistent with the scene's arbitrary scale.
summary: The Epipolar Encoder resolves 3D scale ambiguity by aggregating cross-view features along epipolar lines, unlike standard volume rendering that samples along rays.
